# Free Webinar to Address Electrical Safety & Compliance in the Window Covering Industry

The “Powering Safety” panel will bring industry experts together to discuss electrical, battery and wireless safety requirements

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// September 9, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Free+Webinar+to+Address+Electrical+Safety+%26+Compliance+in+the+Window+Covering+Industry&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fwebinars%2Ffree-webinar-to-address-electrical-safety-compliance-in-the-window-covering-industry%2F)

As [motorization](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/motorization/ "Posts tagged with motorization"), [battery](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/battery/ "Posts tagged with battery") power and connected technology continue to expand across the window covering industry, understanding the safety and compliance requirements behind these products is increasingly important for manufacturers, dealers, fabricators and installers.

_Window Fashion VISION_ will present “Powering Safety: What You Need to Know About [Electrical Safety](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/electrical-safety/ "Posts tagged with electrical safety") & Compliance,” a free, 60-minute webinar on Tuesday, October 13 at 1:00 p.m. ET. The live panel discussion will bring together industry experts to explore the electrical, battery and wireless safety standards that apply to today’s window covering products and components, including motors, controls, remotes, batteries, charging systems, sensors and cables.

The discussion will use the industry white paper [_The Importance of Electrical, Battery and Wireless Safety Certifications for the Window Covering Industry_](https://www.wf-vision.com/motorization/the-new-safety-checklist/) as a resource, translating complex requirements into practical information professionals can use when manufacturing, selling, specifying and installing window covering products.

### **Attendees will learn:**

- Key electrical, battery and wireless safety requirements
- Risks and potential liabilities associated with uncertified products
- How to identify certified products and components
- Questions to ask suppliers about certification and compliance
- What manufacturers, dealers and installers should know before products reach the customer

### **Featured Panelists**

**Tiffany Burlew** — Assembly Specialist, Rollease Acmeda

**Daniel Niemirka** — Senior Product Manager, Somfy

**Ralf Vasami** — Executive Director, Window Covering Manufacturers Association (WCMA)

**Mike Schratz** — Chief Product Officer, Rollease Acmeda

Electrical safety considerations extend throughout the product chain, from manufacturing and sourcing to transportation, installation and use. The webinar is designed to give window covering professionals a clearer understanding of their role in navigating compliance and reducing potential risk.

“Powering Safety: What You Need to Know About Electrical Safety & Compliance” is free to attend, but advance registration is required.

**Webinar Details** Tuesday, October 13, 2026

1:00 p.m. ET

60 minutes

Free to attend \| Registration required

**Register** [**HERE**](https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_AmoUZW5nS9aPhDCGfwxwvw) **now to reserve your spot.**

BONUS RESOURCE: Attendees will also receive access to the free industry white paper, _The Importance of Electrical, Battery and Wireless Safety Certifications for the Window Covering Industry_, which will serve as a resource for the panel discussion. More information [HERE](https://www.wf-vision.com/motorization/the-new-safety-checklist/).

# 2027 Deals Are Already Being Decided. Are You In the Room?

[**jduggan**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/jduggan/)// September 8, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=2027+Deals+Are+Already+Being+Decided.+Are+You+In+the+Room%3F&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fadvertising-and-marketing-tips%2F2027-deals-are-already-being-decided-are-you-in-the-room%2F)
- [![facebook](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/facebook.svg)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fadvertising-and-marketing-tips%2F2027-deals-are-already-being-decided-are-you-in-the-room%2F)
- [![linkedin](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/linkedin.svg)](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fadvertising-and-marketing-tips%2F2027-deals-are-already-being-decided-are-you-in-the-room%2F&title=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fadvertising-and-marketing-tips%2F2027-deals-are-already-being-decided-are-you-in-the-room%2F)
- [![pinterest](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/pinterest.svg)](https://pinterest.com/pin/create/button/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fadvertising-and-marketing-tips%2F2027-deals-are-already-being-decided-are-you-in-the-room%2F&media=&description=)
- [![email](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/email.svg)](mailto:?subject=2027%20Deals%20Are%20Already%20Being%20Decided.%20Are%20You%20In%20the%20Room?&body= "Share by Email")

Your buyers aren’t waiting until January to start deciding. Neither should you.

Here’s a truth the most successful B2B marketers know: the deals that close in Q1 and Q2 of 2027 aren’t going to be won in 2027. They’re going to be won right now — in the second half of 2026 — when buyers are quietly doing their research, building their shortlists, and forming opinions about which products, services and technologies they will purchase and renew.

If you’re not showing up in that window, you’re not in-the-running.

Research shows that 80% of B2B buyers complete approximately 70% of their purchasing journey before they ever contact a vendor\*. The decision is largely made before the conversation even starts.

**The Buyer Journey Starts Earlier Than You Think**

B2B buyers are savvy and evaluate new partnerships carefully. They research, compare, talk to colleagues, and more. They consume content 3 to 6 months before they fill out a contact form or respond to an email. The companies these buyers read about, notice and are exposed to, are the ones that start to build trust with and are the companies that will have a seat at the table when budget is finally signed off.

The companies that wait until 2027 to start reaching and building a relationship with their target audience? They will find out they entered a race where the other runners already have a six-month head start.

**2027 Budgets Are Being Built Today**

Your buyers’ are in active planning mode right now. Q3 and Q4 are when organizations budget and allocate resources for the year ahead. They are making decisions about priorities, partners, vendors, and spend while you’re reading this.

Being visible during that planning season isn’t just smart. It’s table stakes.

Decision-makers need to see your message consistently over time. Think about any relationship. It’s built via a series of interactions over time. [Marketing](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/marketing/ "Posts tagged with marketing") to your prospects is no different. Familiarity doesn’t happen overnight — it compounds, and it pays off exactly when buyers are ready to act.

**This Doesn’t Replace 2027 Marketing Investment. It Amplifies It.**

[Advertising](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/advertising/ "Posts tagged with advertising") in Q3 and Q4 2026 to drive sales in 2027 now is like compound interest. The awareness you build today earns trust over time, so that by the time your buyers are ready to decide — whether that’s February or May or June — you’re not starting from zero. You’re cashing in on the familiarity and relationship you’ve been building for months.

Marketers that advertise consistently through the second half of 2026 enter the new year as a known quantity, not a new face. In B2B, where relationships and reputation drive decisions, that distinction can be the difference between landing on the shortlist and securing new sales in 2027 or being overlooked entirely.

Your 2027 marketing plan deserves a strong foundation. The time to build it is now.

**The Question Isn’t Whether to Invest — It’s Whether You Can Afford to Wait**

Every moment you’re not visible to your buyers is a moment a competitor might be. Sitting out the research phase isn’t cost savings — it’s a missed opportunity with a price tag you won’t see until it’s too late.

The window is still open. Q3 and Q4 are the most powerful times to reach buyers who are actively evaluating options, and position yourself to win in the year ahead.

Your buyers are planning for 2027 investments. Are you?

_Ready to end the year strong and drive B2B sales for the year ahead? [Contact us](https://www.wf-vision.com/advertising/) to learn how we can connect you with the audience that matters most to your [business](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/business/ "Posts tagged with business")._

\* _Sources: [Sopro, State of Prospecting (2025)](https://sopro.io/resources/whitepapers/the-state-of-prospecting-25/)_

2027 Deals Are Already Being Decided. Are You In the Room?

Your buyers aren’t waiting until January to start deciding. Neither should you.

Here’s a truth the most successful B2B marketers know: the deals that close in Q1 and Q2 of 2027 aren’t going to be won in 2027. They’re going to be won right now — in the second half of 2026 — when buyers are quietly doing their research, building their shortlists, and forming opinions about which products, services and technologies they will purchase and renew.

If you’re not showing up in that window, you’re not in-the-running.

Research shows that 80% of B2B buyers complete approximately 70% of their purchasing journey before they ever contact a vendor. The decision is largely made before the conversation even starts.

The Buyer Journey Starts Earlier Than You Think

B2B buyers are savvy and evaluate new partnerships carefully. They research, compare, talk to colleagues, and more. They consume content 3 to 6 months before they fill out a contact form or respond to an email. The companies these buyers read about, notice and are exposed to, are the ones that start to build trust with and are the companies that will have a seat at the table when budget is finally signed off.

The companies that wait until 2027 to start reaching and building a relationship with their target audience? They will find out they entered a race where the other runners already have a six-month head start.

2027 Budgets Are Being Built Today

Your buyers are in active planning mode right now. Q3 and Q4 are when organizations budget and allocate resources for the year ahead. They are making decisions about priorities, partners, vendors, and spend while you’re reading this.

Being visible during that planning season isn’t just smart. It’s table stakes.

Decision-makers need to see your message consistently over time. Think about any relationship. It’s built via a series of interactions over time. Marketing to your prospects is no different. Familiarity doesn’t happen overnight — it compounds, and it pays off exactly when buyers are ready to act.

This Doesn’t Replace 2027 Marketing Investment. It Amplifies It.

Advertising in Q3 and Q4 2026 to drive sales in 2027 now is like compound interest. The awareness you build today earns trust over time, so that by the time your buyers are ready to decide — whether that’s February or May or June — you’re not starting from zero. You’re cashing in on the familiarity and relationship you’ve been building for months.

Marketers that advertise consistently through the second half of 2026 enter the new year as a known quantity, not a new face. In B2B, where relationships and reputation drive decisions, that distinction can be the difference between landing on the shortlist and securing new sales in 2027 or being overlooked entirely.

Your 2027 marketing plan deserves a strong foundation. The time to build it is now.

The Question Isn’t Whether to Invest — It’s Whether You Can Afford to Wait

Every moment you’re not visible to your buyers is a moment a competitor might be. Sitting out the research phase isn’t cost savings — it’s a missed opportunity with a price tag you won’t see until it’s too late.

The window is still open. Q3 and Q4 are the most powerful times to reach buyers who are actively evaluating options, and position yourself to win in the year ahead.

Your buyers are planning for 2027 investments. Are you?

# The Grace Awards Accepting 2027 Submissions

Put your best work in the spotlight and submit your Grace Awards projects by November 29, 2026.

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// September 8, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=The+Grace+Awards+Accepting+2027%C2%A0Submissions&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fgrace-awards%2Fthe-grace-awards-accepting-2027-submissions%2F)

- [![pinterest](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/pinterest.svg)](https://pinterest.com/pin/create/button/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fgrace-awards%2Fthe-grace-awards-accepting-2027-submissions%2F&media=&description=)

[The Grace Awards](http://www.grace-awards.com/), the premier competition celebrating innovation and artistry in custom window treatments, is now open for entries for the 2027 program. This distinguished competition honors designers and artisans who exemplify creativity, craftsmanship and vision, those who transform windows into works of art.

[![](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/image-7-300x200.png)](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/image-7.png)

Now in its 2027 edition, [the Grace Awards](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/the-grace-awards/ "Posts tagged with The Grace Awards") continue to recognize the industry’s most inspiring projects, offering entrants a prestigious platform to showcase their mastery and elevate their professional presence. With [24 diverse categories](http://www.grace-awards.com/categories), participants are invited to submit their finest work across both Design and Artisan divisions, highlighting the depth of talent and innovation within the window covering industry.

Entrants may submit projects through November 29, 2026, at [Grace-Awards.com](http://grace-awards.com/), where they can also explore full category descriptions, judging details and entry guidelines.

**Design Categories Include:**

- Curtains & Draperies
- Top Treatments
- Combination
- Finishing Touch – Decorative Hardware & Trim
- Soft Shades
- Specialty (Arches, Odd Shapes, etc.)
- Whole-Room Integration
- [Motorization](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/motorization/ "Posts tagged with motorization")
- Outdoor Living & Exterior Solutions
- Commercial
- Luxury
- Emerging Designer Award

**Artisan Categories Include:**

- Curtains & Draperies
- Top Treatments
- Combination
- Ingenious Installation
- Bedding & Pillows
- Specialty (Arches, Odd Shapes, etc.)
- Upholstery
- Most Intricate Handwork
- Outdoor Living Craftsmanship
- Soft Shades
- Finishing Touch – Decorative Hardware & Trim
- Emerging Artisan Award

[![](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/image-6-300x197.png)](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/image-6.png)

A distinguished panel of industry experts will independently and anonymously evaluate all submissions from December 7-31, 2026, ensuring that each project is reviewed with fairness, rigor and respect for craftsmanship and innovation. The 2027 Grace Awards will culminate in an elegant awards gala held during the [International Window Coverings Expo (IWCE)](http://www.iwce-vision.com/) in Tampa, Florida. This highly anticipated celebration will honor the industry’s top visionaries and announce the category winners, shining a spotlight on excellence, artistry and collaboration in window fashion.

Designers and artisans are encouraged to enter now and join the legacy of talent, creativity and inspiration that defines the Grace Awards. For more information or to submit your project, visit [Grace-Awards.com](http://grace-awards.com/).

The Grace Awards, the premier competition celebrating innovation and artistry in custom window treatments, is now open for entries for the 2027 program. This distinguished competition honors designers and artisans who exemplify creativity, craftsmanship and vision, those who transform windows into works of art.

Now in its 2027 edition, the Grace Awards continue to recognize the industry’s most inspiring projects, offering entrants a prestigious platform to showcase their mastery and elevate their professional presence. With 24 diverse categories, participants are invited to submit their finest work across both Design and Artisan divisions, highlighting the depth of talent and innovation within the window covering industry.

Entrants may submit projects through November 29, 2026, at Grace-Awards.com, where they can also explore full category descriptions, judging details and entry guidelines.

Design Categories Include:

- Curtains & Draperies
- Top Treatments
- Combination
- Finishing Touch – Decorative Hardware & Trim
- Soft Shades
- Specialty (Arches, Odd Shapes, etc.)
- Whole-Room Integration
- Motorization
- Outdoor Living & Exterior Solutions
- Commercial
- Luxury
- Emerging Designer Award

Artisan Categories Include:

- Curtains & Draperies
- Top Treatments
- Combination
- Ingenious Installation
- Bedding & Pillows
- Specialty (Arches, Odd Shapes, etc.)
- Upholstery
- Most Intricate Handwork
- Outdoor Living Craftsmanship
- Soft Shades
- Finishing Touch – Decorative Hardware & Trim
- Emerging Artisan Award

A distinguished panel of industry experts will independently and anonymously evaluate all submissions from December 7-31, 2026, ensuring that each project is reviewed with fairness, rigor and respect for craftsmanship and innovation. The 2027 Grace Awards will culminate in an elegant awards gala held during the International Window Coverings Expo (IWCE) in Tampa, Florida. This highly anticipated celebration will honor the industry’s top visionaries and announce the category winners, shining a spotlight on excellence, artistry and collaboration in window fashion.

Designers and artisans are encouraged to enter now and join the legacy of talent, creativity and inspiration that defines the Grace Awards. For more information or to submit your project, visit Grace-Awards.com.

# Motionblinds Integrates With Homey Smart Home Platform

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// September 8, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Motionblinds+Integrates+With+Homey+Smart+Home+Platform&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fsmart-home%2Fmotionblinds-integrates-with-homey-smart-home-platform%2F)

[Motionblinds](https://motionblinds.com/), the smart shading brand from [Coulisse](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/coulisse/ "Posts tagged with coulisse"), has integrated with [Homey](https://homey.app/en-us/), allowing its motorized blinds, shades and curtains to connect with the [smart home](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/smart-home/ "Posts tagged with smart home") platform’s more than 850,000 users worldwide.

Developed by Dutch company Athom, part of LG Electronics, [Homey](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/homey/ "Posts tagged with homey") brings connected devices together in a single app. [Motionblinds](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/motionblinds/ "Posts tagged with MotionBlinds") window coverings can now be controlled and automated alongside lighting, climate, security and other smart home products.

[![](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/Extra-beeld_2_staand-240x300.jpg)](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/Extra-beeld_2_staand.jpg) The integration supports the full range of Motionblinds motors through three connection options: Matter over Thread, Matter over Wi-Fi and a local API. Once connected, Motionblinds motors can be incorporated into Homey Flows and automated based on factors such as time, temperature and presence. Voice control is also available through Siri, Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa.

“Homey users already have their home working for them — lights that respond to presence, heating that adjusts automatically. With Motionblinds, their window coverings finally join that story. We’re proud to bring professional-grade motorized shading into one of the most versatile smart home platforms out there — a powerful position for smart home users and every dealer in our global network alike,” said Roy Ebbekink, partner marketing specialist at Motionblinds.

“The best smart home experiences happen when great products work better together. Motionblinds has built an impressive portfolio of smart window coverings for every home and every installation, and we’re excited that every Motionblinds motor now integrates seamlessly with Homey. It’s another step towards giving our users the freedom to choose the products they love without compromise,” said Abe Haverkamp, head of partnerships at Homey.

The Motionblinds app is available in the Homey App Store, with additional information about the integration available at [Motionblinds.com](https://motionblinds.com/).

_Window Fashion VISION_ is now accepting nominations for its 2026 [40 Under 40](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/40-under-40/ "Posts tagged with 40 Under 40") Awards, recognizing outstanding professionals ages 18–39 who are making a meaningful impact on the window covering industry. Since its launch in 2020, the _Window Fashion VISION_ 40 Under 40 Awards have celebrated rising professionals whose leadership, innovation, accomplishments and commitment are helping advance the industry and shape its future.

“The window covering industry is filled with incredible emerging talent across every area of the profession,” said Lindsay Brown, Managing Editor, _Window Fashion VISION_. “From design and fabrication to installation, automation, sales, marketing and manufacturing, these professionals are bringing new ideas, energy and leadership to our industry. The 40 Under 40 Awards give us an opportunity to recognize their accomplishments and celebrate the people who are helping move our industry forward.”

**Who Should Be Nominated?**

_Window Fashion VISION_ is seeking outstanding professionals ages 18–39 who are making a meaningful impact on the window covering industry. Nominees may come from across all areas of the industry, including:

- Workroom and fabrication professionals
- [Interior designers](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/interior-designers/ "Posts tagged with interior designers") who regularly specify custom window treatments
- Installers, integrators and automation professionals
- Retail, dealer and manufacturing professionals
- Sales and business development professionals
- Marketing, social media and communications professionals
- Operations, HR and other industry professionals
- Anyone actively contributing to and helping shape the future of the window covering industry

If they’re making an impact, advancing the industry or demonstrating exceptional potential, Window Fashion VISION wants to hear about them. Industry professionals are encouraged to nominate deserving colleagues, employees, partners and peers. Nominations should highlight the nominee’s accomplishments, contributions to the industry and the qualities that distinguish them as an emerging leader.

**Please note: Past _Window Fashion VISION_ 40 Under 40 honorees are not eligible to win again.**

**Submit an Honoree** Know someone who deserves to be recognized among the window covering industry’s next generation of leaders? Submit them for consideration for the 2026 _Window Fashion VISION_ 40 Under 40 Awards.

Nominations are open now through Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

**Submit an Honoree [here](https://form.jotform.com/262354640965160).**

## Sombra Shades Launches Industry-First Native PoE Drapery Motor

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// September 3, 2026

Sombra Shades’ First-of-Its-Kind PoE Drapery Motor

# Sombra Shades Launches Industry-First Native PoE Drapery Motor

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// September 3, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Sombra+Shades+Launches+Industry-First+Native+PoE+Drapery+Motor&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fmotorization%2Fsombra-shades-launches-industry-first-native-poe-drapery-motor%2F)
- [![facebook](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/facebook.svg)](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fmotorization%2Fsombra-shades-launches-industry-first-native-poe-drapery-motor%2F)
- [![linkedin](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/linkedin.svg)](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fmotorization%2Fsombra-shades-launches-industry-first-native-poe-drapery-motor%2F&title=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fmotorization%2Fsombra-shades-launches-industry-first-native-poe-drapery-motor%2F)
- [![pinterest](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/pinterest.svg)](https://pinterest.com/pin/create/button/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fmotorization%2Fsombra-shades-launches-industry-first-native-poe-drapery-motor%2F&media=&description=)
- [![email](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/email.svg)](mailto:?subject=Sombra%20Shades%20Launches%20Industry-First%20Native%20PoE%20Drapery%20Motor&body= "Share by Email")

[Sombra Shades](https://www.sombrashades.com/), the leader in luxury-grade [motorized shade solutions](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/motorized-shade-solutions/ "Posts tagged with motorized shade solutions"), today announced the launch of its [Native Power over Ethernet (PoE) Drapery Motor](https://www.sombrashades.com/pages/poe-drapery), a first-of-its-kind solution designed to bring direct PoE operation to motorized drapery. The new motor expands [Sombra Shades](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/sombra-shades/ "Posts tagged with Sombra Shades")‘ broader offering of PoE roller shade motors and shade applications, giving dealers, fabricators and [integration](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/integration/ "Posts tagged with integration") professionals a path to deliver unified, [luxury-grade window-covering](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/luxury-grade-window-covering/ "Posts tagged with luxury-grade window-covering") systems.

This motor was developed to address a gap in the motorized drapery market. Traditionally, installers had to choose between [battery](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/battery/ "Posts tagged with battery")-operated systems and hardwired systems that require separate wires for power and data and add installation complexity. The Sombra Native [PoE Drapery Motor](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/poe-drapery-motor/ "Posts tagged with PoE drapery motor") uses Power over Ethernet to combine power and network connectivity through a single low-voltage cable, supporting a cleaner installation while eliminating batteries.

Sombra’s design features a local RF remote control allowing the motor to be operated and programmed directly through its RF remote. This provides responsive everyday control and a practical local-control option independent of a network connection. Additionally, integrators can use its local IP control interface and JSON-based API to integrate the motor with leading third-party control systems, including [Control4](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/control4/ "Posts tagged with Control4") and [Crestron Home](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/crestron-home/ "Posts tagged with Crestron Home"). In partnership with integration companies, Sombra Shades plans to expand to operators.

Key features include:

– Simplified installation: One Ethernet cable delivers both power and connectivity, helping reduce wiring clutter.

– [Battery-free operation](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/battery-free-operation/ "Posts tagged with battery-free operation"): Direct PoE eliminates battery charging cycles, battery replacement and related service demands.

– Local-control reliability: Direct RF remote control and programming provide a responsive local-control option independent of a network connection.

Integration flexibility: A local JSON API supports integration with leading third-party automation platforms.

– Cleaner long-term ownership: The absence of an onboard power buffer removes a component category that can age, lose capacity and eventually require service.

– A complete PoE full offering: The drapery motor complements Sombra Shades’ roller shade motors and broader motorized shade portfolio.

“Drapery was the missing piece of a complete PoE offering,” said Rick Rizner, CTO and Managing Partner at Sombra Shades. “With this motor, we’re giving dealers and integrators a refined solution that brings dual-protocol control together in one product: simple local RF control and programming, along with straightforward integration into the leading control systems their clients already love. It gives them the flexibility of advanced automation without requiring complex software to configure or enjoy it.”

Unlike motor designs that use onboard power reserves, Sombra’s Native PoE Drapery Motor is designed to operate directly from PoE infrastructure without an onboard battery or power buffer. This approach removes a potential long-term maintenance and replacement consideration while providing predictable power from the installed Ethernet network whenever the system is energized.

For dealers and installers, the direct-PoE architecture can simplify troubleshooting by focusing diagnostics on familiar infrastructure components, including the Ethernet run, PoE switch or injector, network connection and motor.

“Dealers want to offer a PoE shading solution without creating extra steps between the shade installer and the integration team,” said Chris Taylor, Executive Sales Officer and General Manager at Sombra Shades. “This motor gives dealers a direct path from installation and setup to control-system integration. The result is a more seamless project experience and a polished, fully integrated luxury solution clients can see and enjoy every day.”

For more information on the Native PoE Drapery Motor, visit [https://www.sombrashades.com/](https://www.sombrashades.com/).

# Redefining Everyday Luxury: Discover the Newest Sunbrella® Lineup at Trivantage

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Redefining+Everyday+Luxury%3A+Discover+the+Newest+Sunbrella%C2%AE+Lineup+at+Trivantage&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Ffabric-collection%2Fredefining-everyday-luxury-discover-the-newest-sunbrella-lineup-at-trivantage%2F%3Futm_source%3D%26utm_medium%3DSponConModule%26utm_campaign%3DTrivantage%26utm_term%3DSeptember2026%26utm_content%3Dredefining-everyday-luxury)

- [![linkedin](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/linkedin.svg)](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Ffabric-collection%2Fredefining-everyday-luxury-discover-the-newest-sunbrella-lineup-at-trivantage%2F%3Futm_source%3D%26utm_medium%3DSponConModule%26utm_campaign%3DTrivantage%26utm_term%3DSeptember2026%26utm_content%3Dredefining-everyday-luxury&title=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Ffabric-collection%2Fredefining-everyday-luxury-discover-the-newest-sunbrella-lineup-at-trivantage%2F%3Futm_source%3D%26utm_medium%3DSponConModule%26utm_campaign%3DTrivantage%26utm_term%3DSeptember2026%26utm_content%3Dredefining-everyday-luxury)
- [![pinterest](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/pinterest.svg)](https://pinterest.com/pin/create/button/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Ffabric-collection%2Fredefining-everyday-luxury-discover-the-newest-sunbrella-lineup-at-trivantage%2F%3Futm_source%3D%26utm_medium%3DSponConModule%26utm_campaign%3DTrivantage%26utm_term%3DSeptember2026%26utm_content%3Dredefining-everyday-luxury&media=&description=)
- [![email](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/email.svg)](mailto:?subject=Redefining%20Everyday%20Luxury:%20Discover%20the%20Newest%20Sunbrella%C2%AE%20Lineup%20at%20Trivantage&body= "Share by Email")

At [Trivantage®](https://www.trivantage.com/), we support makers with high-quality materials that bring creative ideas to life. As demand grows for versatile indoor and outdoor environments, access to trend-forward fabrics and dependable supplies is essential. This month, we are spotlighting two premier fabric collections to elevate your custom upholstery and window treatment projects.

**INTRODUCING THE NEW FUSION COLLECTION**

[![](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/CDN-1200-FY26-FUSION-GLAMOUR-V0052-300x300.jpg)](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/CDN-1200-FY26-FUSION-GLAMOUR-V0052.jpg) Fusion Collection — a versatile palette of solids and prints, exclusively available through Trivantage.

The Sunbrella Fusion Collection, distributed exclusively through Trivantage, is curated specifically to support the creative vision of today’s makers. Featuring 144 SKUs, the collection offers a rich palette of sophisticated solids and intricate patterns designed to bring depth, warmth, and texture to any space — from high-traffic interiors to open-air patios. The collection blends trend-forward aesthetics with the livable performance of Sunbrella, while bridging the gap between elevated design appeal and everyday functionality.

[![](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/CDN-1200-1495725-SB-Fusion-Glamour-Photography-FY26_0005-300x300.jpg)](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/CDN-1200-1495725-SB-Fusion-Glamour-Photography-FY26_0005.jpg) With its mix of high-end style and everyday durability, this fabric line offers more options for creating unique indoor and outdoor spaces.

Built to withstand the demands of real, everyday life, these fabrics deliver exceptional stain resistance, easy cleanability, and long-lasting durability. Every offering in the collection is backed by an industry-leading five-year limited warranty, allowing makers to fabricate and install each fabric with complete confidence.

Designed to seamlessly blur the lines between indoor and outdoor living, the Fusion Collection opens up versatile design opportunities across a variety of applications like furniture upholstery, patio cushions, custom drapery, accent pillows, cabanas, and pool seating areas.

To help bring your designs to life, Trivantage makes ordering easy:

- **No Order Minimums:** Buy what your project requires, from one yard to multiple rolls.
- **Wholesale Pricing:** Direct-to-maker pricing that keeps budgets on track.
- **Fast Shipping:** Most orders arrive within 2 days so your supplies are there when you need them.

**DRAPERY & WINDOW COVERINGS: SOFT ELEGANCE WITH SUNBRELLA® SHEER FABRICS**

[![](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/Sunbrella_NYC_Studio_Livingroom_Lina_Drapery_Stock_V1-_Hero_Room_0049_-edited-2-1-300x200.jpg)](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/17/2026/09/Sunbrella_NYC_Studio_Livingroom_Lina_Drapery_Stock_V1-_Hero_Room_0049_-edited-2-1.jpg) Bring an airy, luminous quality to indoor and outdoor spaces with Sunbrella Sheer Fabrics. Offered at an extra-wide 116-inch width, these semi-sheer textiles allow seamless fabrication across large installations—reducing production time while delivering a soft drape.

Sunbrella Sheers work beautifully as a standalone product or layered with drapery for added texture. Built to resist moisture, mold, and mildew, they can withstand high-humidity spaces with low-maintenance, bleach-cleanable convenience.

Delivery is simple, flexible, and cost-effective through Trivantage’s parcel-friendly shipping, backed by zero order minimums and wholesale pricing. To avoid expensive freight fees, fabric is folded in half and rolled onto a standard tube; any minor transit creasing smooths out effortlessly with gentle steaming. Fabricators can also maximize efficiency by sourcing all project supplies, including high-performance threads, fabrication tools, and other essential materials, in a single, convenient order.

**YOUR PARTNER IN POSSIBILITY**

From custom drapery supplies to specialized tools, Trivantage offers over 9,000 products backed by fast, reliable shipping and technical customer support. Trivantage Plus™ members also enjoy exclusive perks, such as flat-rate shipping and complimentary memo samples to keep projects moving smoothly.

Fabricate with confidence and unlock inspiration for your next custom project at trivantage.com.

**About Trivantage**

At Trivantage, we do more than supply products. We help fabricators bring ideas to life.

For professionals in the shade, marine, and furnishings industries, we offer 9,000+ fabrics, hardware, threads, tools, and more — all backed by wholesale pricing, fast shipping, and expert support. Members of Trivantage Plus™, an industry’s first membership program, enjoy exclusive discounts and benefits to grow their business with confidence and creativity.

Stay connected and inspired: Visit [trivantage.com/newsroom](http://trivantage.com/newsroom) or follow @Trivantage on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

# Carole Fabrics Launches Fall 2026 Collection

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// August 31, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Carole+Fabrics+Launches+Fall+2026+Collection&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Ffabric-collection%2Fcarole-fabrics-launches-fall-2026-collection%2F)

[Carole Fabrics](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/carole-fabrics/ "Posts tagged with Carole Fabrics") has introduced its [Fall](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/fall/ "Posts tagged with fall") 2026 Decorative [Fabric Collection](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/fabric-collection/ "Posts tagged with Fabric Collection"), featuring more than 560 new fabrics spanning heritage-inspired patterns, linen-like textures, colorful prints, embroideries and sheers.

**Archival Influences** features heritage-inspired jacquard wovens with botanical motifs and transitional styling, while **Soft Surroundings** offers drapable solids and textures in a soft, tonal palette.

Four color-focused collections bring prints and embroideries into the mix: **Blue Horizons** explores shades from light sky to deep midnight; **Verdant Vision** ranges from subtle to vibrant greens; **Natural Harmony** features earthy sand-to-sable tones; and **Sunlit Serenity** combines warm golds, oranges and reds with hints of blue.

Rounding out the collection, **La Petite** features small-scale stripes, botanicals, florals and coral patterns, while **Ethereal Elegance** offers narrow sheers with linen-inspired textures, detailed embroideries and colored prints.

Each grouping includes Carole Exclusives, offering designers fresh options for fall projects. To view the collections, explore the Fall 2026 Inspiration Book or order hard-copy sample books, visit [CaroleFabrics.com](https://www.carolefabrics.com/fabric/design-essentials/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=likeshopme&utm_content).

# IFDA Educational Foundation Announces 2026 Grant Winners

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// August 28, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=IFDA+Educational+Foundation+Announces+2026+Grant+Winners&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Findustry-news%2Fifda-educational-foundation-announces-2026-grant-winners%2F)

- [![email](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/email.svg)](mailto:?subject=IFDA%20Educational%20Foundation%20Announces%202026%20Grant%20Winners&body= "Share by Email")

The Educational Foundation of the [International Furnishings and Design Association](https://www.ifda.com/educational-foundation/)( [IFDA](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/ifda/ "Posts tagged with IFDA")) has announced its 2026 grant recipients, awarding $38,500 to support professional development, research and educational initiatives across the design industry.

This year’s funded projects span universal design, historic preservation, color and lighting education, healthcare design and professional development.

“We’re honored to support the inspiring range of projects through this year’s grants,” said Karen Dzendolet, chairman of the board of the Educational Foundation of IFDA. “All the initiatives demonstrate considerable talent and skill and a willingness to take on new challenges.”

**The 2026 grant recipients are:**

- **Irma Dobkin Universal Design Grant ($2,000):** Soheil Jafari, PhD student in design and merchandising at Oklahoma State University
- **Ina Mae Kaplan Historic Preservation Grant ($2,000):** Lisa M. Tucker, PhD, professor at Virginia Tech and director of the Center for Historic Preservation in the School of Design
- **Elizabeth Brown Grant to [Interior Design](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/interior-design/ "Posts tagged with interior design") Programs ($2,500):** Nam-Kyu Park, chair of the Department of Interior Design at the University of Florida
- **Tony Torrice Professional Development Grant ($1,500):** Hamed Yekita, PhD, assistant professor of interior design at Iowa State University
- **Valerie Moran Memorial Grant (up to $3,000):** Jennifer Driscoll, founder of Broadview Marketing and Broadview Tours

“The selection process is challenging with such talented applicants,” said Earline Feldman, FIFDA, director of scholarships and grants. “Each recipient stood out for their vision, dedication and potential to make a meaningful contribution to the field; we are delighted to recognize their achievements.”

[IFDA Educational Foundation](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/ifda-educational-foundation/ "Posts tagged with IFDA Educational Foundation") grants are available to professionals working in interior design and furnishings-related fields. The foundation also provides scholarships for undergraduate and graduate students and funding to support IFDA chapter programming.

For more information, visit [IFDAEF.org](http://ifdaef.org/).

IFDA Educational Foundation Announces 2026 Grant Winners

The Educational Foundation of the International Furnishings and Design Association (IFDA) has announced its 2026 grant recipients, awarding $38,500 to support professional development, research and educational initiatives across the design industry.

This year’s funded projects span universal design, historic preservation, color and lighting education, healthcare design and professional development.

“We’re honored to support the inspiring range of projects through this year’s grants,” said Karen Dzendolet, chairman of the board of the Educational Foundation of IFDA. “All the initiatives demonstrate considerable talent and skill and a willingness to take on new challenges.”

The 2026 grant recipients are:

- Irma Dobkin Universal Design Grant ($2,000): Soheil Jafari, PhD student in design and merchandising at Oklahoma State University
- Ina Mae Kaplan Historic Preservation Grant ($2,000): Lisa M. Tucker, PhD, professor at Virginia Tech and director of the Center for Historic Preservation in the School of Design
- Elizabeth Brown Grant to Interior Design Programs ($2,500): Nam-Kyu Park, chair of the Department of Interior Design at the University of Florida
- Tony Torrice Professional Development Grant ($1,500): Hamed Yekita, PhD, assistant professor of interior design at Iowa State University
- Valerie Moran Memorial Grant (up to $3,000): Jennifer Driscoll, founder of Broadview Marketing and Broadview Tours

“The selection process is challenging with such talented applicants,” said Earline Feldman, FIFDA, director of scholarships and grants. “Each recipient stood out for their vision, dedication and potential to make a meaningful contribution to the field; we are delighted to recognize their achievements.”

IFDA Educational Foundation grants are available to professionals working in interior design and furnishings-related fields. The foundation also provides scholarships for undergraduate and graduate students and funding to support IFDA chapter programming.

# Behr Gets Grounded With Its 2027 Color of the Year

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// August 28, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Behr+Gets+Grounded+With+Its+2027+Color+of+the+Year&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fdesign-and-trends%2Fbehr-gets-grounded-with-its-2027-color-of-the-year%2F)

[Behr](http://www.behr.com/) has named Grounded (T27-01), an earthy olive green inspired by nature, its 2027 [Color of the Year](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/color-of-the-year/ "Posts tagged with color of the year").

Blending moss and olive tones with subtle brown undertones, Grounded taps into the continued desire for interiors that feel warm, restorative and connected to the natural world. The versatile shade is designed to bring a sense of calm to a space while still offering enough depth to make an impact.

“Grounded is a reminder that the most meaningful spaces are the ones that help us connect with the rhythms of everyday life,” said Kayla Kratz, head of color at [Behr](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/behr/ "Posts tagged with behr") [Paint](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/paint/ "Posts tagged with paint") Company. “The shade’s organic warmth creates a sense of calm and renewal, making every room feel inviting and effortlessly livable.”

Grounded anchors Behr’s [2027 Color Trends Palette](https://www.behr.com/colors/color-detail/t27-01), a collection inspired by the beauty and balance of the natural world. The palette spans warm neutrals, earthy tones, muted pinks, clay hues and airy blues, offering plenty of opportunities for layering color throughout the home.

The collection also brings seven Behr legacy colors back into the mix: Coastal Beige, Wheat Grass, Environmental, Denim Light, Smokey Claret, Sarsaparilla and Mozart. Each was selected to complement Grounded and help create cohesive, nature-inspired palettes.

The selection comes as homeowners increasingly look to their interiors as a place to retreat and recharge. According to research conducted by Behr, 86% of Americans say home DIY and design projects help them feel grounded by allowing them to create a safe, comforting haven, while 84% say the right paint color is critical to making a space feel like home.

This year’s announcement also marks the 10th anniversary of Behr’s Color of the Year program, which has evolved over the past decade alongside changing attitudes toward color, design and the role the home plays in everyday life.

To commemorate the milestone, Behr is donating $250,000 to Habitat for Humanity to support affordable homeownership programs and help families create comfortable, stable homes.

Grounded and the complete Behr 2027 Color Trends Palette are available in Behr Dynasty, Behr Marquee, Behr Ultra and Behr Premium Plus paints through The Home Depot.

The collection also brings seven Behr legacy colors back into the mix: Coastal Beige, Wheat Grass, Environmental, Denim Light, Smokey Claret, Sarsaparilla and Mozart. Each was selected to complement Grounded and help create cohesive, nature-inspired palettes.

The selection comes as homeowners increasingly look to their interiors as a place to retreat and recharge. According to research conducted by Behr, 86% of Americans say home DIY and design projects help them feel grounded by allowing them to create a safe, comforting haven, while 84% say the right paint color is critical to making a space feel like home.

This year’s announcement also marks the 10th anniversary of Behr’s Color of the Year program, which has evolved over the past decade alongside changing attitudes toward color, design and the role the home plays in everyday life.

To commemorate the milestone, Behr is donating $250,000 to Habitat for Humanity to support affordable homeownership programs and help families create comfortable, stable homes.

Grounded and the complete Behr 2027 Color Trends Palette are available in Behr Dynasty, Behr Marquee, Behr Ultra and Behr Premium Plus paints through The Home Depot.

El próximo 23 de septiembre, [Asefave](https://www.asefave.org/) organizará el webinar ‘Digitalización del documento de control, carta de porte y eCMR, en el que se abordará la transformación digital de la documentación vinculada al transporte por carretera y los nuevos requisitos que deberán afrontar las empresas ante la próxima obligatoriedad del Documento de Control (DeCA) en formato digital, que entrará en vigor el 5 de octubre de 2026. La sesión se impartirá de 12 a 13 horas, en formato online.

![Imagen](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5755257.jpeg)

Durante la sesión se analizarán las principales novedades normativas, las diferencias entre el Documento de Control, la Carta de Porte, el CMR y el eCMR, así como los requisitos técnicos y legales necesarios para garantizar su correcta utilización.

La sesión será impartida por Docuten, quien explicará de forma práctica cómo afrontar esta transición y qué soluciones existen para digitalizar estos documentos de manera segura, trazable y conforme a la normativa.

También se abordarán aspectos como la firma electrónica, el acceso a la documentación durante las inspecciones, el almacenamiento y la trazabilidad de los documentos, así como la integración con los sistemas de gestión actuales y la evolución hacia el modelo europeo eFTI.

Una oportunidad para conocer de primera mano cómo prepararse para este nuevo escenario normativo y cómo convertir la digitalización de la documentación de transporte en una herramienta para mejorar la eficiencia y la operativa de las empresas.

Los interesados en este webinario pueden inscribirse [aquí.](https://docuten.clickmeeting.com/como-implementar-correctamente-el-deca-antes-del-5-de-octubre/register)

El día anterior a la jornada se enviará el enlace a las personas registradas.

Asefave will organize a webinar on the digitalization of the control document, bill of lading, and eCMR on September 23. The webinar will address the digital transformation of documentation related to road transport and the new requirements companies will face with the upcoming mandatory digital format for the Control Document (DeCA) which will take effect on October 5, 2026. The session will run from 12 to 1 PM, online.

During the session, the main regulatory updates will be analyzed, including the differences between the Control Document, the Bill of Lading, the CMR, and the eCMR, as well as the technical and legal requirements needed to ensure their proper use.

The session will be conducted by Docuten, who will practically explain how to approach this transition and what solutions exist for the secure and traceable digitalization of these documents in compliance with regulations.

Additionally, aspects such as electronic signatures, document access during inspections, document storage and traceability, as well as integration with current management systems and the evolution towards the European eFTI model will be discussed.

This is an opportunity to learn firsthand how to prepare for this new regulatory scenario and how to turn the digitalization of transport documentation into a tool to improve the efficiency and operations of companies.

Interested participants can register for the webinar. A link will be sent to registered individuals the day before the event.

title: Akena strengthens its growth in Spain with a new agency in Badalona
summary: Akena, a French firm specialized in outdoor solutions, is expanding in Spain with a new showroom in Badalona, enhancing direct customer interaction. This strategic step aligns with their growth plan, introducing verandas and high-quality products previously well-established in France. The company aims to increase brand recognition and improve collaboration with both distributors and end consumers.

# Akena afianza su crecimiento en España con una nueva agencia en Badalona

[José Luis París](https://www.interempresas.net/autores/jose-luis-paris)

La firma francesa [Akena](https://www.akena.com/es), especializada en verandas, pérgolas y soluciones premium para espacios exteriores, ha inaugurado un nuevo showroom en Badalona (Barcelona), un paso estratégico dentro de su plan de expansión en la península ibérica. La nueva agencia permitirá acercar la marca al cliente final y reforzar tanto la actividad comercial como la colaboración con profesionales del sector.

Akena continúa consolidando su implantación en España con la apertura de esta nueva agencia, un espacio expositivo desde el que la compañía pretende dar a conocer su amplia gama de soluciones para el acondicionamiento de espacios exteriores y reforzar la notoriedad de una marca con una larga trayectoria en Francia, donde cuenta con más de 45 años de experiencia.

La inauguración supone un nuevo hito dentro de la estrategia de crecimiento de la compañía en el mercado español. Según explicó Tristan Savary, coordinador de la Red Comercial de Akena en España, la empresa ha comenzado a trasladar al mercado ibérico un modelo comercial que lleva décadas funcionando con éxito en Francia, basado en una red propia de agencias, asesoramiento personalizado y equipos de instalación propios. “Queremos que el cliente conozca la marca Akena y no solo al distribuidor”, señaló.

![El equipo comercial de Akena en España, ante la nueva agencia de la firma francesa en Badalona](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5726579.jpeg)

El equipo comercial de Akena en España, ante la nueva agencia de la firma francesa en Badalona.

Hasta hace pocos años la compañía trabajaba en España exclusivamente a través de distribuidores. Sin embargo, la experiencia adquirida en el mercado llevó a la empresa a apostar también por la venta directa al cliente particular para incrementar su visibilidad. Así, durante los últimos meses Akena ha incorporado comerciales en Barcelona, Madrid, Málaga y Valencia, una estructura que continuará creciendo con la apertura de nuevos showrooms.

La elección de Badalona no es casual. Savary explicó que la empresa buscaba un emplazamiento bien comunicado, con fácil acceso desde Barcelona y suficiente superficie para albergar una exposición permanente de sus productos. Además, la ubicación, en una zona comercial especializada en equipamiento para el hogar y el jardín, permite acercarse al perfil de cliente al que se dirige la compañía.

## La veranda, eje de la estrategia de crecimiento

La oferta de Akena se divide en dos grandes familias de soluciones: la ampliación de la vivienda mediante verandas y los productos destinados al disfrute del exterior, entre los que destacan las pérgolas bioclimáticas, las pérgolas de lona retráctil, los techos móviles, los ‘carports’ (cubiertas para automóviles) o ‘las pool houses’ (construcciones para piscina).

Aunque las pérgolas bioclimáticas representan actualmente uno de los productos con mayor demanda en el mercado español, la empresa quiere introducir con fuerza el concepto de veranda, muy implantado en Francia, pero todavía poco conocido en nuestro país. Para Savary, existe una diferencia fundamental entre ambos sistemas: “La veranda no es un simple cerramiento; es una auténtica extensión de la vivienda, diseñada para utilizarse durante todo el año, gracias a sus cualidades de estanqueidad y rendimiento térmico y acústico”.

![La veranda es la solución más destacada del catálogo de Akena...](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5726580.jpeg)

La veranda es la solución más destacada del catálogo de Akena. Este producto supone una eficaz y consistente manera de ampliar la vivienda aprovechando su espacio exterior.

Para ello, Akena apuesta por una construcción con rotura de puente térmico en todos sus perfiles de aluminio, dobles y triples acristalamientos y diferentes soluciones de protección solar que permiten mantener el confort tanto en verano como en invierno.

“Empezamos hace 45 años fabricando únicamente verandas y sigue siendo el producto que queremos desarrollar en España”, afirmó Savary, convencido de que el mercado español ofrece un importante potencial para este tipo de soluciones conforme aumente su conocimiento entre arquitectos, instaladores y usuarios finales.

![Las verandas de Akena están conformadas con perfiles de aluminio de rotura puente térmico, con sistemas correderos de doble acristalamiento...](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5726581.jpeg)

Las verandas de Akena están conformadas con perfiles de aluminio de rotura puente térmico, con sistemas correderos de doble acristalamiento.

## Fabricación propia y soluciones de alta gama

Uno de los principales elementos diferenciadores de Akena es que controla todo el proceso, desde el diseño y la fabricación hasta la instalación final. Todos los productos se fabrican íntegramente en Francia y llegan preparados para facilitar el montaje, reduciendo tiempos de instalación y minimizando posibles incidencias.

“Tomamos las dimensiones, fabricamos cada proyecto a medida y son nuestros propios equipos quienes realizan el montaje”, explicó Savary. Este modelo permite mantener un elevado control de calidad y ofrecer soluciones completamente personalizadas.

![Las pérgolas bioclimáticas de Akena son la otra gran propuesta de la firma francesa](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5726582.jpeg)

Las pérgolas bioclimáticas de Akena son la otra gran propuesta de la firma francesa.

La compañía apuesta además por un posicionamiento claramente premium. Sus pérgolas incorporan tornillería oculta, screens totalmente integrados en la estructura, iluminación LED directa e indirecta, amplias posibilidades de personalización y grandes dimensiones sin necesidad de pilares intermedios.

Entre las soluciones más innovadoras destaca el cristal inteligente Sage Glass, exclusivo de Akena, capaz de modificar progresivamente su nivel de opacidad para reducir hasta un 98% la radiación solar y el calor incidente, mejorando el confort sin renunciar a la entrada de luz natural.

## El showroom como herramienta comercial

La nueva agencia de Badalona no solo funcionará como punto de venta, sino también como un espacio donde los clientes podrán conocer físicamente los productos antes de tomar una decisión. Tras una primera visita técnica al domicilio, Akena invita al cliente al showroom para revisar el proyecto, visualizar dimensiones, acabados y equipamientos y resolver cualquier duda antes de formalizar el pedido.

Según Savary, este proceso permite que “el usuario comprenda mejor el resultado final y valore las distintas posibilidades de personalización que ofrece cada solución”.

El nuevo espacio también servirá como centro de formación para el equipo comercial de la compañía, facilitando el conocimiento de las distintas gamas de producto y la puesta en común de experiencias entre los comerciales de las diferentes zonas.

![Los showrooms de Akena permiten que los clientes finales puedan hacerse una idea real de las soluciones que podrán disfrutar en sus hogares...](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5726583.jpeg)

Los showrooms de Akena permiten que los clientes finales puedan hacerse una idea real de las soluciones que podrán disfrutar en sus hogares, como la pérgola Airbio, con techo móvil, un diseño exclusivo de Akena.

## Nuevos pasos en España

![Imagen](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5726584.jpeg)

Tras la apertura de Badalona, Akena prevé inaugurar nuevos showrooms en Madrid y Málaga dentro de su plan de expansión en España. Paralelamente, la compañía continuará reforzando su colaboración con distribuidores y profesionales, especialmente en aquellas zonas donde el modelo de proximidad siga siendo el más adecuado.

La estrategia de crecimiento del grupo contempla además la progresiva incorporación al mercado español de nuevas soluciones y marcas de su cartera, con el objetivo de ampliar su oferta y responder a las distintas necesidades del mercado del ‘outdoor’ y la ampliación de viviendas.

CURRENT NEWS

The company will open new showrooms in Madrid and Málaga in the coming months.

Akena strengthens its growth in Spain with a new agency in Badalona.

The French company Akena, specialized in verandas, pergolas, and premium solutions for outdoor spaces, has inaugurated a new showroom in Badalona (Barcelona), a strategic step in its expansion plan in the Iberian Peninsula. The new agency will bring the brand closer to the end customer and strengthen both commercial activity and collaboration with professionals in the sector.

Akena continues to consolidate its presence in Spain with this new agency, an exhibition space from which the company intends to showcase its wide range of solutions for outdoor space conditioning and enhance the visibility of a brand with a long history in France, where it has over 45 years of experience.

The inauguration marks a new milestone in the company's growth strategy in the Spanish market. As Tristan Savary, coordinator of Akena's Commercial Network in Spain, explained, the company has begun to transfer to the Iberian market a commercial model that has been successfully functioning in France for decades, based on a proprietary network of agencies, personalized advice, and in-house installation teams. “We want the customer to know the Akena brand and not just the distributor,” he noted.

Until a few years ago, the company worked in Spain exclusively through distributors. However, the experience gained in the market led the company to also bet on direct sales to individual customers to increase its visibility. Thus, in recent months, Akena has incorporated salespeople in Barcelona, Madrid, Málaga, and Valencia, a structure that will continue to grow with the opening of new showrooms.

The choice of Badalona is not casual. Savary explained that the company was looking for a well-connected location, easily accessible from Barcelona, and with enough space to house a permanent exhibition of its products. Additionally, the location, in a commercial area specialized in home and garden equipment, allows the company to approach the type of customer to whom it is directed.

The veranda is the axis of the growth strategy.

Akena's offer is divided into two main families of solutions: extending the home through verandas and products intended for enjoying the outdoors, among which stand out bioclimatic pergolas, retractable canvas pergolas, mobile roofs, carports, or pool houses.

Although bioclimatic pergolas currently represent one of the most in-demand products in the Spanish market, the company wants to strongly introduce the concept of veranda, which is well established in France but still little known in our country. For Savary, there is a fundamental difference between the two systems: “The veranda is not just a simple closure; it is a true extension of the home, designed to be used year-round, thanks to its waterproofing qualities and thermal and acoustic performance.”

To achieve this, Akena bets on construction with thermal break in all its aluminum profiles, double and triple glazing, and various solar protection solutions that allow maintaining comfort both in summer and winter.

"We started 45 years ago manufacturing only verandas, and it remains the product we want to develop in Spain," Savary stated, confident that the Spanish market offers significant potential for these types of solutions as awareness grows among architects, installers, and end users.

Own manufacturing and high-end solutions.

One of Akena's main differentiating elements is that it controls the entire process, from design and manufacturing to final installation. All products are manufactured entirely in France and arrive ready to facilitate assembly, reducing installation times and minimizing potential incidents.

“We take the measurements, manufacture each project to measure, and our own teams carry out the installation,” explained Savary. This model allows for high-quality control and offering completely customized solutions.

The company also opts for a clearly premium positioning. Its pergolas include concealed screws, screens fully integrated into the structure, direct and indirect LED lighting, wide customization possibilities, and large dimensions without the need for intermediate pillars.

Among the most innovative solutions is the smart glass Sage Glass, exclusive to Akena, capable of progressively changing its opacity level to reduce up to 98% sunlight radiation and incident heat, improving comfort without sacrificing natural light entry.

The showroom as a commercial tool.

The new agency in Badalona will not only function as a sales point but also as a space where customers can physically see the products before making a decision. After a first technical visit to the home, Akena invites customers to the showroom to review the project, visualize dimensions, finishes, and equipment, and resolve any doubts before formalizing the order.

According to Savary, this process allows “the user to better understand the final result and appreciate the various customization possibilities that each solution offers.”

The new space will also serve as a training center for the company’s sales team, facilitating knowledge of the different product ranges and sharing experiences among salespeople from different areas.

New steps in Spain.

After the opening in Badalona, Akena plans to inaugurate new showrooms in Madrid and Málaga as part of its expansion plan in Spain. At the same time, the company will continue to strengthen its collaboration with distributors and professionals, especially in those areas where the proximity model continues to be the most appropriate.

The group’s growth strategy also contemplates the gradual incorporation of new solutions and brands from its portfolio into the Spanish market, aiming to expand its offer and meet the different needs of the outdoor and home extension market.

El hogar se abre cada vez más al exterior. Terrazas, porches, balcones o grandes ventanales se convierten en espacios protagonistas donde la luz natural, la sombra y el confort cobran una nueva importancia en el día a día. En este contexto, las soluciones de protección solar y control de la luz adquieren un papel clave para crear ambientes agradables y preparados para disfrutar del día a día con mayor bienestar.

Bajo esta idea, [Bandalux](https://bandalux.com/), multinacional española especializada en el diseño, fabricación y distribución de cortinas y soluciones de protección solar a medida, propone distintas soluciones pensadas para acompañar la vida en casa y aprovechar mejor los espacios exteriores, adaptándose a diferentes espacios y formas de habitar.

![Bandalux cuenta con diversas soluciones para extender el hogar hacia el exterior y disfrutar de estos espacios durante gran parte del año...](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5753362.jpeg)

Bandalux cuenta con diversas soluciones para extender el hogar hacia el exterior y disfrutar de estos espacios durante gran parte del año.

## Disfrutar de los espacios exteriores

Terrazas, balcones y patios se convierten cada vez más en una prolongación natural del interior. Lugares donde compartir tiempo al aire libre y cuya comodidad depende, en gran medida, de poder adaptar las condiciones del espacio.

La gama de toldos Bandalux está diseñada para acompañar esta forma de vivir el exterior, creando zonas de sombra que ayudan a reducir la exposición directa del sol y favorecen una sensación de mayor confort durante el día. Desde balcones y ventanas hasta terrazas de mayor tamaño, las distintas soluciones permiten adaptar cada espacio a las necesidades de uso sin renunciar a la entrada de luz ni a la sensación de apertura.

![La gama de toldos de Bandalux crea grandes zonas de sombra y confort, sin renunciar a la entrada de luz en el interior](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5753363.jpeg)

La gama de toldos de Bandalux crea grandes zonas de sombra y confort, sin renunciar a la entrada de luz en el interior.

Además de ayudar a reducir la exposición solar, los toldos contribuyen a crear ambientes más íntimos y agradables, integrándose de forma natural en el espacio y en la estética del hogar.

## Controlar la luz y el calor sin desconectarse del exterior

En viviendas con grandes ventanales, zonas abiertas o espacios especialmente expuestos al sol, controlar la entrada de luz y resulta clave para adaptar el ambiente a los diferentes momentos del día.

En este contexto, Z-Box se presenta como una solución de cortina exterior pensada para proteger frente al sol, el viento y las altas temperaturas, ayudando a mejorar tanto el confort visual como térmico. Su diseño permite regular la entrada de luz de forma más precisa y crear interiores más agradables sin perder conexión con el exterior.

![Z-Box, cortina exterior de Bandalux diseñada para proteger frente al sol, el viento y las altas temperaturas](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5753364.jpeg)

Z-Box, cortina exterior de Bandalux diseñada para proteger frente al sol, el viento y las altas temperaturas.

Gracias a su integración discreta y a su comportamiento frente a condiciones climáticas exigentes, Z-Box se adapta tanto a proyectos residenciales como a espacios hospitality o contract donde el bienestar y la protección solar son fundamentales.

## Luz natural y protección en un mismo espacio

Para quienes buscan mantener las vistas y la luminosidad incluso en espacios protegidos, Z-Box Cristal ofrece una solución especialmente pensada para disfrutar del entorno sin renunciar al confort.

Su tejido transparente permite cerrar porches, terrazas o pérgolas manteniendo una sensación visual abierta y luminosa. El resultado son espacios más protegidos frente al viento o la humedad, pero conectados con el exterior y bañados por luz natural.

![El tejido transparente Z-Box Cristal permite mantener las vistas y la luminosidad incluso en espacios protegidos](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5753365.jpeg)

El tejido transparente Z-Box Cristal permite mantener las vistas y la luminosidad incluso en espacios protegidos.

## Un hogar más conectado con el exterior

Más allá de su función técnica, las soluciones de Bandalux responden a una nueva forma de entender el hogar en la que interior y exterior están cada vez más conectados: espacios abiertos, luminosos y preparados para adaptarse a distintos momentos y usos. Crear sombra, regular la luz o proteger determinados espacios ya no responde únicamente a una cuestión funcional, sino también a la búsqueda de bienestar y confort cotidiano. Soluciones que permiten adaptar terrazas, balcones y ventanales y convertirlos en una parte cada vez más integrada de la vida en casa.

# A-OK Motors \- Motores para toldos

### A-OK Motors AM60 Plus FSK WIFI

## Motores tubulares: vía radio, con final de carrera electrónico

![Foto de Motores tubulares](https://img.interempresas.net/FotosArtProductos/P223883.jpg)

El motor tubular AM60 Plus FSK Wifi vía radio, con final de carrera electrónico y frecuencia 863.3 mhz FSK, está diseñado para toldos de gran tamaño.

Incorpora tecnología Wi-Fi bidireccional, sistema que permite el conrol de cualquier espacio y seguridad en caso de alarmas meteorológicas en base a algunos parámetros. Características:

\- Diámetro de 60 mm.

\- Final de carrera electrónico.

\- Dos opciones de programación: doble final de carrera o cierre por presión.

\- Bidireccionalidad con sensores climáticos.

\- Posibilidad de desactivar el sensor sol desde el emisor.

\- Radio receptor incorporado.

\- Frecuencia 869.3 mhz.

\- Módulo receptor superheterodino de alta sensibilidad (-110 dbm).

\- Superficie resistente a la humedad.

\- Estructura de freno patentada en ambos lados.

\- Posición de freno de autocorrección.

\- Sensores detectores de número de vueltas.

\- Tecnología Wi-Fi bidireccional.

# El Foro Iberoamericano volverá a tener un gran protagonismo en Veteco

La [Asociación Española de Fabricantes de Fachadas Ligeras y Ventanas (Asefave)](https://www.asefave.org/) considera muy buena noticia que el Foro Iberoamericano del Cerramiento Acristalado vuelva a ser uno de los principales focos de interés de la próxima edición de [Veteco](https://www.ifema.es/veteco), que se celebrará del 10 al 13 de noviembre en Ifema Madrid, dentro de la Semana Internacional de la Construcción.

El Foro Iberoamericano está formado, además de por Asefave, por las siguientes asociaciones: Anfaje (Portugal), Amevec (México), asovensa (República Dominicana), Acolvise (Colombia), Apevic (Perú), Afeal (Brasil), Aluvi (Paraguay) y Achival (Chile).

Como viene siendo habitual, durante la celebración de Veteco tendrá lugar la reunión de las mencionadas asociaciones que integran el Foro Iberoamericano, en la que se realizará un balance de la actividad desarrollada durante los dos últimos años y se debatirá sobre los principales retos que afronta el sector en un ámbito geográfico cada vez más interconectado.

![El Foro Iberoamericano del Cerramiento Acristalado volverá a reunirse en Veteco 2026](https://img.interempresas.net/fotos/5751816.jpeg)

El Foro Iberoamericano del Cerramiento Acristalado volverá a reunirse en Veteco 2026.

La entidad se felicita por esta nueva reunión de las entidades del Foro Iberoamericano, ya que considera que el mismo se ha consolidado como un espacio de referencia para fortalecer las relaciones entre las asociaciones del sector a ambos lados del Atlántico, compartir experiencias y analizar las oportunidades de crecimiento en un mercado estratégico para la industria española del cerramiento.

En esta edición, además, Colombia será el país invitado de la Semana Internacional de la Construcción, por lo que contará con una participación especialmente destacada en las actividades del Foro Iberoamericano, reforzando así los vínculos entre ambos mercados.

A pocos meses de la celebración de una nueva edición de Veteco, feria impulsada y patrocinada por Asefave, la entidad celebra las cifras ofrecidas por Ifema Madrid, lugar donde se celebrará tan importante cita del sector. Hasta el momento, cerca de un centenar empresas nuevas o que no estuvieron presentes en la edición de 2024 han confirmado su presencia en la actual convocatoria.

Para Asefave, estos datos confirman “el excelente momento que atraviesa el sector y consolidan a Veteco como el gran punto de encuentro de la industria del cerramiento, la fachada y la protección solar, así como un espacio imprescindible para impulsar la innovación, la internacionalización y la eficiencia energética en la edificación”.
